[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.8.3 - repairs[/b][/size]

Repair only, from one playthrough of the Knights of Saladin route.

[b]Amir had nothing to say.[/b] 0.7.0 restored his Montserrat directions, but put them on the
greeting he uses for strangers, not the one he uses for a Favored One. Nobody could have seen
them. They are now where he actually says them.

[b]The trials were stripping your order.[/b] A character holds one faction; assigning another
replaces it, rank and bonuses included. Two earlier releases assumed a Templar or Inquisitor
could also be a Knight of Saladin, so winning the trials quietly unmade a sworn character, and
their next promotion quietly unmade the Knight. Saladin content now keys on the [i]title[/i]: take
the trials and you are a Favored One whatever order you serve, your own order untouched. A
character with no order still becomes a Knight of Saladin outright.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. Amir's fix works on any save; the rest needs a
character who has not yet entered the Gate District.
